programme.desc: The Rainbow Warriors (2-6, 1-4) visit the Miners (1-7, 0-4) for a Mountain West affair. The programs haven't met since 2004, when they were Western Athletic Conference foes. Hawaii traveled 4,255 miles to beat Northern Illinois 56-21 last week.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 8 UCLA Bruins (8-0) face the Minnesota Golden Gophers (5-3) at Huntington Bank Stadium for a Big Ten game. UCLA enters undefeated in eight games after shutting out Nevada 27-0, while Minnesota is coming off a 23-16 overtime defeat to Indiana.

programme.title: College Football

programme.desc: A nun helps a double murderer deal with his actions and prepare for his execution in a New Orleans prison.

programme.desc: Intent on drinking himself to death, a man (Nicolas Cage) who has lost everything finds solace with a Las Vegas hooker (Elisabeth Shue).
